source: Generated by this same approximate model from explicitly recorded synthetic truth; no measurement or added noise.

forward_thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
forward_thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

limitations: Same-model synthetic data establish software recoverability only. A qualified fit does not establish process endpoint acceptance; see forward_example_endpoints. Jacobian rank is local identifiability, not global uniqueness. Defects/strength/absorption are unvalidated proxies; DSC is net thermal boundary power per initial dry mass in stored-gas mode, not an instrument-specific prediction.
forward_count_definition: Truth + every residual call including numerical differences + final fitted readback; instrumented run_cycle calls, not optimizer nfev.
model_version_scope: Current 271-parameter model with carbonate phase resistance and gas-pair pore resistance fixed at nominal one; their ranges and identifiability are not covered.

independent_saved_output_arithmetic.gas_ledger_recorder_limitation: Original gas_ledger_present inspected report.whole_cycle, but the ledger is report.gas_species_ledger. Its false values do not establish missing or failed gas ledgers. No per-forward gas-ledger qualification follows from this recorder.
independent_saved_output_arithmetic.local_rank_note: Local default numerical Jacobian rank, not global uniqueness, noise robustness or real-material identification.

elapsed_definition: Original elapsed_s is fit only. full_demonstration_elapsed_s is actual CLI operation including one shared truth forward and its in-memory mapping audit.

truth_audit_retention.limitation: First full-cycle truth is supported by actually recorded summary diagnostics only. No reconstructed or separately rerun full truth budget. Final fitted forward mass/element/energy budgets, free-water ledger, thermodynamics, state domain and dimension check are retained by fit. The existing fit output does not retain the top-level gas-species ledger; this P06 run does not independently qualify that ledger.
